content.value_statement: Production incidents demand fast, coordinated decisions across technical and business teams. This skill structures triage, mitigation, investigation, communication, recovery, and postmortem work.
actual_capabilities: Classifies incidents from P0 through P3 using impact, outage, security, and data-loss criteria.
Structures response work across triage, mitigation, investigation, recovery, communication, and prevention phases.
Creates focused prompts for observability, debugging, security, performance, deployment, and documentation roles.
Defines incident command responsibilities and communication channels for coordinated decisions.
Produces guidance for stakeholder updates, customer impact assessments, and status reporting.
Outlines blameless postmortems, monitoring improvements, and system hardening actions.
limitations: The skill provides guidance only and has no direct monitoring, paging, deployment, or communication integrations.
Production actions require authorized operators, environment-specific validation, testing, and rollback controls.
Named subagent types may not exist in every Claude, Codex, or Claude Code environment.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the packaged skill.

use_cases.title: Direct an active outage
use_cases.description: Classify impact, assign response roles, prioritize mitigation, and maintain a clear decision timeline.
use_cases.target_user: Incident commanders and site reliability engineers

use_cases.title: Assess a security incident
use_cases.description: Coordinate observability review, exposure analysis, containment planning, and stakeholder communication.

use_cases.title: Lead post-incident learning
use_cases.description: Build a blameless timeline, identify contributing factors, assign improvements, and strengthen monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Classify an incident
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify this incident using P0 through P3: [alerts and impact]. List affected services, user impact, initial roles, and missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage from an alert or user report

prompt_templates.title: Plan mitigation and updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a mitigation and communication plan for [incident]. Include immediate containment, rollback triggers, owners, validation checks, and update audiences.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate root cause
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [logs, metrics, traces, and recent changes] for [incident]. Identify the likely root cause, contributing factors, and evidence gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Correlating technical evidence after initial mitigation

prompt_templates.title: Orchestrate the full response
prompt_templates.prompt: Coordinate an end-to-end response for [incident]. Produce phased actions for triage, mitigation, investigation, deployment, communication, recovery, and a blameless postmortem.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced coordination across technical and business teams

output_examples.input: Checkout errors reached 35 percent after a release, but other services remain healthy.
output: Severity: P1 because a revenue-critical path has major user impact.
Immediate action: pause the rollout, compare healthy and affected instances, and prepare rollback.
Validation: track checkout success, latency, error rate, and failed transactions before closing mitigation.

output_examples.input: Prepare a postmortem outline for a 42-minute authentication outage caused by expired certificates.
output: Timeline: detection, escalation, certificate diagnosis, replacement, validation, and service recovery.
Contributing factors: missing expiry alerts, unclear ownership, and incomplete renewal procedures.
Actions: assign certificate inventory, expiry monitoring, renewal testing, and runbook updates with deadlines.

best_practices: Confirm incident scope, operator authority, affected services, and success criteria before proposing production changes.
Maintain a timestamped decision log with owners, evidence, mitigation results, and stakeholder updates.
Validate every mitigation with health checks, user-impact metrics, and a tested rollback path.
anti_patterns: Do not execute production changes without authorization, staged validation, and rollback readiness.
Do not declare a root cause when evidence only supports correlation or an untested hypothesis.
Do not include secrets, personal data, or unnecessary customer details in prompts and incident updates.

faq.question: Does this skill connect to monitoring or paging tools?
faq.answer: No. It organizes analysis and response prompts but does not provide direct integrations.

faq.question: Can it execute emergency production changes?
faq.answer: No. Authorized operators must review, approve, execute, and validate every production action.

faq.question: Which incident severities does it support?
faq.answer: It uses P0 through P3 classifications for critical outages, major degradation, minor degradation, and cosmetic issues.

faq.question: Does it cover security incidents?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides breach assessment, suspicious activity review, exposure analysis, containment planning, and communication.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide alerts, user impact, affected services, recent changes, available telemetry, current mitigations, permissions, and response objectives.

faq.question: Can it create a postmortem?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure a blameless timeline, contributing factors, lessons, and assigned prevention actions.
